displayIdentity.body: Mutual bodily authority, abstinence, and gift. Now about the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman. Yet I wish that all men were like me. However, each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.
displayIdentity.title: Mutual bodily authority, abstinence, and gift
